findings.problem: In the phone frames for beats 3–6, the corner plan box covers the second half of the heading 'First, what the question says' while the voice reads it, so the student sees 'First, what the ques…' under the box.
findings.fix: Keep the heading clear of the corner plan: shorten it, or start it below the plan box, so the whole heading shows at phone width.

findings.problem: The hand font draws the part headings in capitals, '(A)', '(B)', '(C)', and the voice says 'part A' and 'part C'. Here A and B are also points on the screen, so 'Part C wants the acceleration at A' is easy to misread.
findings.fix: Write the headings as 'Part (a)', 'Part (b)', 'Part (c)' in maths font (or keep lower case), so a part is never confused with point A or B.

findings.rule: every move says what, how, why
findings.problem: The line jumps from −20π sin(πt/3) × π/3 to −20π²/3 sin(πt/3) with no reason given. Beat 18 said 'sixty times pi over three is twenty pi', but here nothing is said.
findings.fix: Say 'Twenty pi times pi over three is twenty pi squared over three' as line 13 is written.

findings.problem: The voice says T is measured from when the dot passed through O, but the board only writes 't: time (s)'. That start point is why x = 0 at t = 0.
findings.fix: Write 't: time (s) after passing O' on the words 'since the dot passed through O'.
